transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a re-entry case to review today — a student found responsible for damaging common-area property in a residence hall, scheduled to return to campus next week. Before I sign off on the plan, I'd like to follow our normal procedure. Could the conduct officer, residence-life coordinator, and counseling director each share any case information that should be included before we finalize this re-entry plan? The draft packet currently recommends a 10-day suspension, $500 restitution, return to the student's current room, in-person conduct check-ins, and a general counseling referral.
